description: Human-identified QA issues. These are the ONLY entries that change qaStatus. Content is never rewritten automatically; questions marked NEEDS_REVISION or REJECTED are withheld from quiz sessions until revised.

issues.detail: Keyed answer says changing 7 µV/mm to 14 µV/mm makes waveforms larger. A larger µV/mm value is LOWER display sensitivity: the same voltage gives a smaller deflection. The stem also calls this an increase in sensitivity, and the explanation contradicts the keyed answer.
Keyed option is '0.16 Hz' but its own text and the explanation compute LFF = 1/(2π × 0.1 s) ≈ 1.6 Hz. The option '1.6 Hz' is the correct value.
Keyed answer places P3 at '20% of the distance from Cz to the left ear, along the parietal line'. P3 lies on the left parasagittal line between C3 and O1 (posterior to C3), not on the Cz-to-ear line.
